answer_1.quote: In this work, we leverage abstract meaning representation (AMR) to generate syntactically diverse paraphrase pairs.

answer_2.quote: We consider the following automatic metrics for lexical diversity: • 1 -BLEU (↑) • 1 -∩/∪ (↑) ... We consider the following automatic metrics for syntactic diversity: • TED-3 (↑) • TED-F (↑)

answer_3.quote: we use perplexity to filter out bad paraphrases. Specifically, we consider the GPT-2 model implemented by HuggingFace's Transformers to compute the perplexity of a candidate paraphrase.

answer_4.quote: We used the Amazon Mechanical Turk to conduct the human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated on 3-point scales for semantic similarity and syntactic diversity with defined scores for each level.
